STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, box_fell) -> u1
(u0, at_exit & holding_box) -> u3
(u0, else) -> u0
(u1, holding_box) -> u0
(u1, else) -> u2
(u2, else) -> u2
(u3, else) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u1, holding_box, u0) -> 0.1
(u0, at_exit & holding_box, u3) -> 1.0
feedback: Accepted. The machine is a faithful and minimal encoding of the task. Structure: u0 nominal, u1 the one-step immediate-pickup window, u2 the violation sink, u3 the success terminal; the FINAL_STATES header is present and u3 is declared in STATES and is the accepting state for the task. Semantic fidelity: u1 is entered only on box_fell and both outgoing edges of u1 leave it after exactly one step, so (u1, holding_box) -> u0 fires precisely when the step right after the fall is a pickup; holding_box is the correct pickup predicate because a fall empties the hands and box_fell and holding_box never co-occur, making the u0->u1->u0 cycle unambiguous. The exotic due-step pickup case (action applies first, then the fall fires, so box_fell with empty hands at step end) is handled correctly: the machine re-arms in u1 and demands another immediate pickup on the next step. Regressions: returning to u0 re-arms (u0, box_fell) -> u1, so the second fall (2-6 steps after the pickup, in half the episodes) is checked the same way as the first. Prohibition: reaching the exit with empty hands falls into a zero-reward non-final branch from every state (u0 else stays u0, u1 else goes to u2), so only at_exit & holding_box from u0 pays the 1.0 terminal, and the absorbing u2 sink permanently forfeits the terminal reward after any late pickup, matching the strict reading that the move right after every fall has to pick the box up. Reachability: the first fall always fires by step 8 (drop is disabled before it) and the fallen box always lands in a cell the agent then faces, so u1, u2 and u3 are all reachable and the immediate pickup is always executable, so the requirement is satisfiable. Irrelevant events: siren_ringing and switch_toggled are absorbed by the else edges of every state; toggling the switch instead of picking up on the step after a fall correctly counts as a miss. Reward safety: both reward entries refer to existing transitions; at most two falls occur per episode, bounding progress reward at 0.2 plus a single 1.0 terminal; u2 and u3 are absorbing with zero reward and falls are environment-scheduled (later pickups fire no fall), so nothing is farmable and the shaping is dense but bounded. Format matches the paper layout exactly: header lines, & conjunctions, rewards keyed (state, event, next-state) consistent with the transition list. No defects found.

def siren_ringing(env): return env.siren_ringing
def switch_toggled(env): return "toggle" in env.events_this_step
def holding_box(env): return env.carrying is not None and env.carrying.type == "box"
def box_fell(env): return "fall" in env.events_this_step
def at_exit(env): return env.grid.get(env.agent_pos[0], env.agent_pos[1]) is not None and env.grid.get(env.agent_pos[0], env.agent_pos[1]).type == "goal"
